description: This file defines the SearchMerge class for merging search metadata in the SuiteCRM application, extending ListViewMerge. It manages loading, merging, and saving search view configurations, handling panels and fields within search definitions.

classes.name: SearchMerge
classes.description: A class for merging search metadata for modules in SuiteCRM, extending ListViewMerge to handle specific search view configurations, including loading data, merging fields and panels, and saving merged configurations.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom metadata files into internal data structures for merging.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts fields and their metadata from panels for processing, including their location.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Builds panels for the merged data, prioritizing custom source fields and preserving order.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Sets the panel section of the new data after merging.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Writes the merged data to a specified file.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs the merging process for search metadata, including loading data, merging, and optionally saving the result.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges template metadata, particularly maxColumns settings, into the new data.
